conclusions.text: Year-end entries moved $545,630 of general fund pay onto grants and fees; $617,530 came back.

notes.text: The same entry put pay on Comprehensive school health, ESSER III (pandemic), IDEA (special education), Student Opportunity Act, and others; it does not pair each line with one grant.

conclusions.text: The largest: $187,339 of paraprofessionals pay moved onto grants in one FY2024 entry.

notes.text: So that year the general fund carried coaches’ pay first booked to the fee fund, not the other way round.

conclusions.text: In FY2025, $120,009 of the athletic fee fund’s pay moved onto the general fund, $106,317 to coaches.

notes.text: The FY2023 entry calls it a portion of one person’s pay; the name is redacted.

conclusions.text: $35,400 moved between extended day and the family engagement grant in each of the four years.
